PauseCut browser edition uses unmodified third-party artifacts:

@ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15 (MIT)
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
License text: ffmpeg-LICENSE.txt

@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 (GPL-2.0-or-later; underlying libraries retain their licenses)
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/main/packages/core
License text: core-GPL-2.0.txt
This is the official single-thread ESM core, with FFmpeg and libx264, retrieved
from the versioned npm registry tarball. See versions.json for versions and SHA512
integrity checks. Upstream build scripts and dependencies:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/main/build
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/releases
https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html

@ffmpeg/core-mt 0.12.10 (GPL-2.0-or-later; underlying libraries retain their licenses)
Official multithread ESM core and pthread worker, with FFmpeg and libx264.
Same upstream source, license text, build scripts and dependency notices as core.
Retrieved from the versioned npm registry tarball; SHA512 verified against npm
metadata before extraction. See versions.json and asset-sha256.json.

No third-party telemetry, analytics, uploads, or remote CDN loading is added.
